key.name: panel-mode
key.description: Selects how usage appears in the top panel: 'icon', 'compact-pills', or 'full-text'.

key.name: panel-box
key.description: Which GNOME top bar box holds the indicator: 'left', 'center', or 'right'.

key.name: panel-position
key.summary: Position index within the selected top bar box
key.description: Zero-based index inside the chosen panel box.

key.name: auto-hide-when-empty
key.summary: Hide indicator when no active providers are present
key.description: Automatically hides the top bar indicator when zero visible providers are configured or discovered.

key.name: density-mode
key.description: Controls whether the main popover displays 'detailed' multi-bucket cards or 'compact' single-line rows.

key.name: theme
key.description: Selects the popover theme preset: 'midnight-slate', 'system', 'tokyo-night', 'catppuccin', 'gruvbox', 'rose-pine', 'nord', or 'everforest'.

key.name: font-style
key.description: Selects 'system' tabular UI font or 'monospace' developer font.

key.name: metric-mode
key.description: Controls whether bars and labels display percentage 'used' or percentage 'remaining'.

key.name: refresh-interval-seconds
key.description: How often the extension triggers a background status collection when active.

key.name: hidden-providers
key.description: List of canonical provider IDs hidden from the top bar and main popover.

key.name: binary-path
key.summary: Optional custom path to gnome-agent-status binary
key.description: Overrides automatic binary discovery when non-empty.
